tbesh_html:
1) to be small, be insignificant
1a) (Qal) to be insignificant
1b) (Hiphil) to make small, reduce significantly

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (rather denominative from H6996 (קָטָן));
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.
